verdict.rationale: Bento offers an AI-assisted builder ("Describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's powerful AI build it for you") and an MCP server letting an AI assistant query subscribers, broadcasts, and events through natural conversation, which could surface data-driven insights on request. However there is no explicit documentation of native AI-generated insights, analytics recommendations, or proactive suggestions surfaced inside the product dashboard itself. missing for 10: dedicated AI insights/analytics feature in-product, examples of AI-generated suggestions from user data, independent corroboration of this capability.
